newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mobutu may return home this week but not sure.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu may return home this week but not sure.

text.p: Ailing Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko may return to his country from France later this week but there are no definitive plans for him to do so, an official close to his entourage said on Sunday.
"He is definitely not going back tomorrow. He may leave later in the week but nothing is certain," the official told Reuters.
"If anything is decided we will only know in the 12 hours preceding his return," the official said.
He spoke after Tutsi-led rebels captured Kisangani, Zaire's third largest city, apparently without a fight, as Mobutu's notoriously ill-disciplined troops fled the city after looting it.
Mobutu has spent most of his time in Europe since undergoing an operation for prostate cancer in August.
The official who spoke to Reuters said Mobutu was "feeling better.
